supersession_note: The active research questions, claims, evidence roles, and execution order are defined only by v3_core_research_program_v1.json. All project-created gates and the older three-external-track/head-pass program below are retained as development provenance and have no future execution or verdict authority. Cost is the only project-defined metric that remains active.

source_revision.history_policy: Historical contracts and outcomes remain immutable evidence. This authority governs only future V3 interpretation and execution.

evaluation_freeze.rule: Data identity, exam, pass margin, statistical unit, and claim boundary must be frozen before a head can be judged learned or formally failed.

research_claim.system_claim: See v3_core_research_program_v1.json: one PM makes strategy and typed-memory allocation decisions, evaluated first by official ESConv, ESC-Eval, and ES-MemEval outcomes plus Cost.
research_claim.primary_component_predicate: strategy_value AND memory_system_value AND count(useful(MP), useful(MS), useful(ME)) >= 2
research_claim.first_target_configuration: No memory head is preselected from legacy internal panels; at least two are identified by outcome-blind ES-MemEval official-metric component ablations.

evidence_layers.primary: ESC-Eval official seven-dimension 0-to-4 evaluation with two independent blinded human reviewers, plus hard reliability and executor gates; ESC-RANK remains descriptive automation
evidence_layers.robustness: ESC-Judge pairwise E-I-A is optional sensitivity only and cannot control generator selection; hosted Nemotron is descriptive-only after its full-screen reliability hard failure
evidence_layers.cannot_prove: PM routing value, longitudinal memory, clinical safety

evidence_layers.primary: ES-MemEval official QA, summarization, and dialogue-generation tasks after version reconciliation
evidence_layers.cannot_prove: RS response strategy value or independent new-user replication beyond EvoEmo's shared 18 users

evidence_layers.primary: Frozen same-state comparisons against always-off, fixed-high, transparent-rule, cost-matched-fixed, cost-and-ON-rate-matched-random, component-minus, and safe-oracle controls
evidence_layers.cannot_prove: Absolute chatbot competence without generator qualification

measurement_hierarchy.primary: Same-state Quality, atomic source-aware Risk, and measured Cost deployment-ITT contrasts.
measurement_hierarchy.structural: Requested-to-received accounting, owner/time validity, prompt exposure, schema validity, and leakage guards.
measurement_hierarchy.mechanism_secondary: Source-aware Function as nonzero attributable mechanism evidence; generator self-report is invalid and Function is not a sole first-version veto.
measurement_hierarchy.objective_triangulation: ES-MemEval retrieval, Token F1, BERTScore, conflict, abstention, and false-answer outcomes.

generator_prerequisite.name: ESC-Eval official seven-dimension primary plus optional ESC-Judge sensitivity
generator_prerequisite.role: Qualify the frozen generator before formal PM claims.

ESConv.role: RS and immediate single-session emotional-support response

EvoEmo.role: RS plus longitudinal MP/MS/ME response value, component marginal effects, and joint interactions
EvoEmo.externality: external-corpus and synthetic; not independent from ES-MemEval

ES_MemEval.role: longitudinal retrieval, extraction, temporal reasoning, conflict detection, abstention, and user modeling
ES_MemEval.version_discrepancy: WWW 2026 paper reports 1209 QA questions; local plans mention a 1427-question public artifact; historical V5.2 used 418 questions.

pm_pass_shape.versus_always_off: Quality and atomic Risk noninferior; learned-ON slice has positive same-state value.
pm_pass_shape.versus_fixed_high: Quality and atomic Risk noninferior; actual generator input tokens at least 10% lower; output completeness cannot be the saving mechanism.
pm_pass_shape.versus_transparent_rule: Pareto noninferior with at least one preregistered strict selection improvement.
pm_pass_shape.versus_cost_matched_fixed: At matched resource cost, learned PM is strictly better on a primary Quality, atomic Risk, or verified mechanism outcome while remaining noninferior elsewhere.
pm_pass_shape.versus_matched_random: At the same component ON counts and within 5% injected cost, learned state-action matching strictly improves a primary outcome with noninferior atomic Risk.
pm_pass_shape.component_accountability: Every counted head has nonzero reproducible source-aware contribution and useful full-minus-component or ON/OFF marginal behavior.
pm_pass_shape.joint_policy: No structurally invalid action; safe-oracle quality regret and excess-cost bands pass.

current_scientific_state.RS: Old replacement treatment is negative evidence and is not reusable as an additive-RS verdict. V4 R0-plus-RS-delta exists and remains externally unqualified.
current_scientific_state.MS: V1.1 development promotion was not met: Quality 1 win / 3 losses / 2 neutral, no material Risk increase, zero observable Function across 6 judged USE/ASK cases.
current_scientific_state.MP: V1.1 showed Quality 5 wins / 1 loss / 1 neutral with no material Risk increase, but zero attributable Function across 5 CONSTRAIN cases; plan-first constraint treatment is required.
current_scientific_state.ME: Deferred bounded rescue; not required before RS plus two memory heads can be attempted with MP and MS.
current_scientific_state.external_stress_test: 42 of 90 generator calls are schema-valid; 48 are missing due provider HTTP 429. The incomplete arm matrix permits no scientific decision.
current_scientific_state.generator: The 24-card ESC-Eval development generation is complete: Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen 3.7 Plus non-thinking/thinking each have 24 complete dialogues; hosted Nemotron failed both 0.95 reliability gates. ESC-RANK completed 651/651 local scores at $0 but was format-incompatible under the strict parser and saturated under the anchored sensitivity, so it did not select a generator. The proposed 144-call adapted E-I-A canary was superseded before any call (0 calls, $0). Two independent blinded ESC-Eval seven-dimension packets are now materialized for all 72 eligible dialogues; the numerical development decision contract was frozen before human scores. Human A/B completion and any predeclared Human C adjudication are the only remaining inputs before a development generator decision.

execution_phases.name: workspace_and_evaluation_freeze
actions: Reconcile dataset versions, hashes, sample counts, statistical units, and overlap; resolve or explicitly name the ES-MemEval 1209-versus-1427 identity.
Audit ESC-Eval, freeze its official seven-dimension human-primary role and ESC-RANK's descriptive role, and keep ESC-Judge E-I-A and low-burden guardrails separate as sensitivity/project measures.
Freeze outcome-blind margin derivation and atomic Risk event adjudication while preserving UNCERTAIN as a separate outcome.
Separate active tests from historical replay tests and bind the V3 evidence manifest.
execution_phases.exit: COMPLETE: all nine design gates pass the V3 validator; no inference or formal verdict is thereby authorized.

execution_phases.name: measurement_and_generator_qualification
actions: Materialize the repaired ESC-RANK runtime with pinned base/adapters and strict full-string ordinal parsing.

Complete the already-materialized Human A/B packets for all 72 reliability-eligible development dialogues on ESC-Eval's official seven dimensions; use Human C only for predeclared disagreement/integrity escalation.
Complete dual-review non-formal Quality/Risk calibration and register numeric margins before formal outcomes.
Select and freeze one generator for every subsequent learned-policy and baseline arm.
execution_phases.exit: Scorer/judge runtime, numeric calibration values, Risk fixture qualification, and selected generator are content-addressed and qualified.

execution_phases.name: frozen_external_stress_diagnostic_disposition
actions: If Llama 3.1 8B is retained, complete exactly the 48 missing physical calls under the already frozen continuation plan after explicit approval.
If the generator changes, preserve the 42/90 run as an immutable incomplete diagnostic and do not mix generators inside its arm matrix.
Use any complete diagnostic only to locate treatment/executor failure; do not tune samples, thresholds, or selectors from it.
execution_phases.exit: The old stress panel is either honestly completed on 8B or formally archived as generator-incompatible; no mixed-stack verdict is issued.

execution_phases.name: bounded_treatment_repair
actions: Repair only heads whose P1/P2 evidence shows negative or unidentifiable treatment value.
Use invariant R0 plus bounded RS delta, plan-first MP constraint, and response-plan-relevant MS USE/ASK/IGNORE.
Do not refit selectors until fixed treatments are qualified.
execution_phases.exit: RS, MP, and MS each have safe positive development evidence with nonzero attributable mechanism support.

execution_phases.name: selector_and_policy_freeze
actions: Fit low-capacity grouped/cross-fitted selectors on development-only outcomes.
Freeze thresholds, baselines, margins, action compiler, cost accounting, and judge identities.
Verify learned selection beats a named transparent rule before external confirmation.
execution_phases.exit: A deployable nondegenerate RS+MP+MS policy and all matched controls are content-addressed.

execution_phases.name: formal_external_chain
actions: ESConv RS response track.
EvoEmo longitudinal response and full-minus-component track.
ES-MemEval current official memory-capability track.
execution_phases.exit: All task-specific gates pass without cross-task pooling and the primary component predicate is met.

execution_phases.name: robustness_and_optional_me
actions: Replicate PM value under one outcome-blind stronger generator if a generator-agnostic claim is desired.
Attempt bounded ME rescue only if it adds claim value without delaying the primary RS+MP+MS result.
execution_phases.exit: Report generator-specific or generator-robust claims honestly; ME is included only if independently qualified.
